_comment: Slice 433 item 6, cut point per recording. Each clip has its own recording, store-dino-<device label>-video-<clip>.mp4, made by .maestro/dino/store-shot-ios-video-<clip>.yaml, which starts on the held page: the unrecorded store-shot-ios-videoprep-<clip>.yaml did all navigation (dialogs, loading, waits) first. Beside each recording ios-sim-store-shots.sh writes store-dino-<device label>-video-<clip>.mark, one number: the seconds from the recorder's start to the first step-end line Maestro printed for the clip flow (a line ending COMPLETED, or WARNED when an optional wait such as the hold times out: the end of its first step). A clip is cut from max(0, mark - beforeMark) for `seconds`; beforeMark is how much of the first step's hold (or tail of the first step) is kept before the mark, never more than that hold. store-media.mjs and ios-sim-store-shots.sh both fail a recording shorter than max(0, mark - beforeMark) + seconds. Per clip: 1a-reading: first step is a 1.5 s hold, then the page turns, then a 3 s hold: 1.0 s of hold, the turn lands right after the mark. 1b-voices: the only step is a 6 s hold (the read is going), so the recording ends at the mark: beforeMark = seconds, the last 3 s of the read. 2-record: the first step is the tap on the book's ... button (no hold), so beforeMark is 0 and the cut starts at that tap's end. 3-language-*: the only step is a 3 s hold, the recording ends at the mark: beforeMark = seconds, the last 1 s of the held page. 4-shelf: first step is a 0.8 s hold, then two scrolls: 0.5 s of hold kept, the second scroll starts about 1 s after the mark and is moving inside the window. Tune beforeMark on a contact sheet of a real recording (npx hyperframes snapshot) in the device stage. Keep each clip on one line: the shell script reads it with sed.
